description: Ministry of Lands - Appointment of an Acquiring Officer (to the acquire the surrounding areas of Deduwa Ela for Sri Lanka Tourist Board) Mr. M.B.H.M. Dayaratne to the D/S/D Benthota from 01.01.2017 to 31.03.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It specifically appoints an officer for land acquisitions in the Dedduwa Ela area under the Land Acquisition Act. The content focuses on property acquisition procedures and the appointment is made specifically for land-related administrative functions, not general government personnel changes. This fits the Land Gazette category (Type 4) which includes land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative matters.
